prompt:
Write an original historical fiction story titled "The Last Impression".

Write this story in English.
Use third-person narration outside quoted speech and dreams.
Use past-tense narration outside quoted speech and dreams.
Preserve this physical rule: The damaged press cannot make a clean impression with wet paper; the council register, not a rumour, determines the printing licence.
Follow the supplied three-chapter order.
Keep the disputed leaflet intact until its custody transfer in chapter three.
Keep Miriam alive through the end of chapter three.
Present remembered scenes as past events rather than current events.

Use the supplied character, place and chronology bible. Let the unresolved questions develop through the supplied outline without treating a plan or dream as an event.

outline.title: The Wrong Watermark
outline.purpose: Develop The Last Impression through its planned state changes.
outline.turn: The workshop roll listed Jonas as Jonas Reed, apprentice.
hookSeeds: The disputed leaflet carried a watermark shaped like a broken wheel.
One line of type contained a letter from a different font.
Miriam kept a sealed packet addressed to a man called Dunn.

outline.title: The County Copy
outline.purpose: Develop The Last Impression through its planned state changes.
outline.turn: The birth register established that Jonas’s legal name was Jonas Dunn.
hookSeeds: The broken wheel appeared in the mill’s retired watermark ledger.
The mismatched letter remained visible in the disputed line.
A correction proof bore the same date as the unopened packet.

outline.title: A Clean Impression
outline.purpose: Develop The Last Impression through its planned state changes.
outline.turn: The council register entered Elise as a licensed master printer.
hookSeeds: The retired watermark and dated ledger identified the paper stock as older than the licence period named in the accusation.
The mismatched letter belonged to the former mill owner’s private press.
The packet contained Jonas’s mother’s apprenticeship request under the name Dunn.
The dated proof showed Miriam had prepared a correction before the threat arrived.

authorIntent: Let changing evidence alter trust without turning uncertainty into a completed event.
currentFocus: Preserve the difference between confirmed state, speech, recollection and conjecture.
